result.keyword: What's the best e-signature software for a small business?
result.markdown:
For most small businesses, I'd recommend **Dropbox Sign for simplicity, signNow for affordability, or DocuSign for the best all-round professional solution.**

The best choice depends on how many contracts you send, how many employees need access, and whether you need more than just collecting signatures.

Here are the platforms I'd shortlist in 2026.

## Best e-signature software for small businesses

![Contact Us - Dropbox Sign (Formerly HelloSign)](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/2VacXMMTTAgLv7_tt9CJxRpEx64Pjdo05gOaYRqtaqOv6KLxCsUP9-2-W7fx1bnMTt_RL4ZXXh__9W1oXFphP9NExRIi8BcpBDReMEtSDtlVDQ7gDFbeNxPpubzRi7-28SBjZTZCAw-IRi-qLBsueOgBlB_x3ZAOb2OMkNF-TBUC4p1hEHxhdxeKDroXElUm?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Dropbox Sign** (Best for most small businesses)

Simple, clean interface for sending contracts, collecting signatures and tracking documents. Good for businesses that don't need complicated workflows.

**Best for\:** Service businesses, consultants and small teams.

Indicative starting price: US\$15/month, annual billing.

[Official website](https://sign.dropbox.com/)

---

![Best e-signature software | Tom's Guide](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/wmbNwQd5sZcCQM_y8xDHl0CPe7pgdwCT-krxdtJ31tc_1PKqy7PiBHAl_-Gd913WdMSfKG4tvcbm87CrehlVzyh0S_XfsJoy8bGchL0mjaA3hnz0pBJgnLcUXZcQanS1poRpGWtqsda_EXu0W3Y1sz9Tm8p7il83hsR4mOfYqnnCRPXfp1UL4Ot3PT4uhG1W?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. signNow**

(Best budget option)

Good core signing features, reusable templates, document routing and team collaboration. Particularly attractive if several employees need to send documents.

**Best for\:** Small businesses wanting to keep subscription costs down.

Indicative starting price: US\$8/user/month, annual billing (plan limits apply).

[Official website](https://www.signnow.com/)

---

![ドキュサイン / Docusign について](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/xyLq-c8NsrpmXngTDQOlq_nQ-hdoipi8LNAM0PriPm9OXbxzSMFpxHq4mX20RE5oKykXn_ebymihRHVC-xJF-ftlT3muOwPqVZr1LnypOPP6tZDIkDq6IjuWnsebSgjW-6slAQlpUZa-Wz9woFg0UDt6Xeug0D4ulHXJQLs86h2xGptBRDNSUfxqteGaxXDR?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. DocuSign**

(Best all-round professional option)

Widely recognised by customers and suppliers. Strong document workflows, audit trails, integrations and administration features.

**Best for\:** Businesses signing contracts regularly or dealing with larger organisations.

Indicative starting price: US\$11/month for Personal; higher plans for teams.

[Official website](https://www.docusign.com/)

---

![PandaDoc buys Denario for consolidated document and payment workflow offering](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/nMZU-ikvjF7B27p2YRYbwMFVYldny8ofYsWDYYkqTXdGfrk-N9sresjiQS7_N5GL_z3bC2xtBlASA1wbjcPGc7QwN2zoEnDhBBAByuwL6PooRYdhb5Xb7bjGtsls49X_kKuOQ8O8ieH---UeiE5fGOQC1qFIRtUd6uc0-JR89a70cw5k0Vpz1IUhRMFOX01b?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. PandaDoc**

Great if you want to create professional proposals, quotes and contracts as well as collect signatures. Includes document templates and sales workflow features.

**Best for\:** Sales teams, agencies and businesses sending client proposals.

Indicative starting price: US\$19/user/month, annual billing.

[Official website](https://www.pandadoc.com/)

---

![Adobe Acrobat Sign Solutions for business Transaction New](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/boFV63978924LtJqDW6sL1JIitAIaS-BthRNk192q0PHK-HvHdZBMxqDjDCO72LE2oPF1ayxecsE94Q-YPvxHO-S7Mi38P9TmXNhPAUlm7-8leU4NJBCSUCriipzFK7eQRBF1P54X7oN4viJGvAqlvPFeHJwJMDSU5H8EIj-uBFDS8q0gO8ZF29lIfJEU-lB?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Adobe Acrobat Sign**

Excellent for businesses that already use Adobe Acrobat and regularly edit, prepare and sign PDF documents.

**Best for\:** PDF-heavy businesses and Microsoft 365 workflows.

Indicative starting price: US\$16.99/license/month for a team plan.

[Official website](https://www.adobe.com/acrobat/business/e-sign.html)

Pricing is indicative, in USD, and may vary by country, billing frequency, plan and sending limits. Check Australian pricing before subscribing. [helpcompare.com](https://helpcompare.com/e-signature/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.softwarecompare.net](https://www.softwarecompare.net/comparison/best-esignature-software?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[dupple.com](https://dupple.com/learn/best-e-signature-software?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## My recommendation

If I were choosing for a small Australian business\:

| Your situation | My pick |
|--------|--------|
| General contracts and agreements | Dropbox Sign |
| Lowest-cost team solution | signNow |
| Professional client-facing contracts | DocuSign |
| Quotes and sales proposals | PandaDoc |
| Editing and signing PDFs | Adobe Acrobat Sign |


One important consideration in Australia: electronic signatures are generally valid for most business transactions, provided the method identifies the signer, demonstrates their intention and meets reliability requirements. Some documents have special rules, particularly deeds and documents requiring witnessing. [www.ag.gov.au](https://www.ag.gov.au/legal-system/electronic-signatures-documents-and-transactions?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.ag.gov.au](https://www.ag.gov.au/legal-system/electronic-signatures-documents-and-transactions/electronic-signatures?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.ags.gov.au](https://www.ags.gov.au/publications/legal-briefing/lb-20230904?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## Let me narrow it down to the best one for your business

I have three questions that would make a real difference to my recommendation.

**1\. What type of business do you run?**

---

**2\. How many documents do you expect to send for signing each month?**

**3\. How many people in your business need to send documents?**

**4\. What do you mainly need it for?**

Select all that apply.

I'll use those answers to recommend one platform rather than leave you with five choices.

search_results.description: This 2026 guide evaluates leading e-signature platforms for functionality, security, integrations, usability, device compatibility, and legal compliance. Adobe Acrobat Sign is named the best overall option, offering extensive customization, authentication, SAP SuccessFactors integration, mobile and web access, and plans starting at $16.99 monthly with a seven-day trial. DocuSign is recommended for business value, particularly high-volume signing, with templates, tracking, reporting, strong security, broad integrations, and plans from $10 monthly. Dropbox Sign is the budget choice, emphasizing ease of use, cloud-storage compatibility, branding, templates, and AES-256/TLS encryption from $9.99 monthly. eSignatures.io suits freelancers needing pay-as-you-go bulk contracts, charging per contract with discounted credits. SignNow is best for multiple signers, offering collaboration, reusable templates, drag-and-drop fields, and real-time tracking. PandaDoc is recommended for creating sophisticated documents, combining e-signatures with publishing tools, templates, content libraries, CRM integrations, and payment tracking. The guide advises selecting software based on workflow, compliance, security, features, integrations, and budget.
